The '''16th Legislative Assembly of Assam''' succeeds the 15th Assembly of Assam and will be constituted sooner following the [[National Democratic Alliance]]'s victory in the [[2026 Assam Legislative Assembly election|2026 assembly election]] that was held on 9 April 2026.
